target: self.root / human-surface Frank v0.1 on accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS

audited_executor.method: read the programs that produce the receipts; re-execute in a disposable /tmp copy; sabotage one guard

headline: Enforced mechanisms are consistently stronger than the receipts describing them. Reading receipts alone understates the engineering and overstates the measurements.

findings.label: MEASUREMENT_REPORTING_INFLATION
findings.statement: Check denominators cannot fall. check() raises before the receipt is written, so only 20/20 or no receipt exists. The V17 gate reports 18 checks of which 14 are hardcoded True literals; only 4 are computed.
findings.remediation: checks[name] = bool(cond); assert all(checks.values()) once at the end. Failing runs then produce a readable partial receipt instead of a stack trace.
findings.pull_request: gschaidergabriel/Dr.-Unterweger — candidate patch for the V17 gate

findings.label: EVIDENCE_CLASS_OVERSTATED
findings.statement: DIRECT_FRANK_V0_1_EFFECT_AUTHORITY_EXECUTABLE_POLICY_ORACLE binds to claycode/frank_effects.clay by literal substring containment over 13 markers. Nothing is parsed, typed, lowered or executed. Inverted .clay semantics would still emit PASS.
findings.remediation: Reclassify to PYTHON_POLICY_ORACLE_WITH_CLAY_SIGNATURE_PRESENCE_CHECK until a ClayCode evaluator can run decide_effect from source against the same 20 cases.
findings.note: This is the project's own 'typed frontend != complete compiler' falsifier occurring inside the flagship gate.

findings.label: BENCHMARK_MEASURES_WRONG_PATH
findings.statement: gate_latency_us samples one reused READ_ONLY request through the first branch of the if-chain. It is one warm enum comparison in CPython, not gate latency over the decision space.
findings.remediation: Sample the full request matrix including destructive paths with confirmation application, or drop the figure from summaries.

findings.label: RESTART_SEMANTICS_OVERSTATED
findings.statement: restart_between_reentry_and_done_recovers_nonterminal_state is a context-manager close/reopen inside one process. No termination, signal or fsync path. It demonstrates DB-derived recovery state only.
findings.remediation: Rename to reentry_state_survives_connection_reopen_same_process so the F-V01-13 crash oracle is not read as pre-closed.

findings.label: BOOT_ANCHOR_CONTRADICTS_OWNER_FIXED_TARGET
findings.statement: Repo-root CLAUDE.md declares 'Frank v0.1 voll lauffaehig auf Andreas PC' four times, while FRANK_V0_1_SERVER_BINARY_IDENTITY_AND_API_DIRECTIVE.md:18 explicitly supersedes 'Andreas PC = final target' and FRANK_V0_1_ONLY_PROGRAM_DIRECTIVE.md:13 fixes TARGET_BODY = accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS.
findings.impact: Every fresh organ boots into a superseded mission anchor at T0 and the MISSION REENTRY section re-applies it once per material step. No probe detects this.
findings.remediation: Align repo-root CLAUDE.md with TARGET_BODY = accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS, or state explicitly why the PC anchor survives.

confirmed_strengths.statement: Non-cognitive authority is enforced, not merely declared. evaluate() never reads model_confidence, gwt_ignition, claygraph_salience or translator_effect_hint. 1000/1000 randomized policy-field mutations change request_hash; mutating all four cognitive fields leaves it identical.
confirmed_strengths.assessment: Strongest single result in the audited set.

confirmed_strengths.statement: The presence lease serializes through SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE with epoch-guarded optimistic fencing, not a process-local lock. Contenders are real threads released by a barrier.
confirmed_strengths.residual_gap: Threads share one process; cross-process acquisition is argued rather than demonstrated. A multiprocessing variant closes this cheaply.

confirmed_strengths.statement: V17 carries a real prior negative baseline (FRANK-V01-EFFECT-REENTRY-GAP-31406627821) that names its falsified claim and the concrete hole, and the invariant is carried by six schema-level RAISE(ABORT) triggers rather than application code. Verified by sabotage.
confirmed_strengths.assessment: Correct method. Should be propagated to work packages that currently claim improvement without a prior failing baseline.

structural_context.note: Stated so that peripheral component PASSes are not read as progress at the center. Not a defect claim.

scope_limits: Three of roughly 200 probes were read line by line — the three quoted most prominently in the 2026-08-11 handoff snapshot.
Findings A1/A2/A3 are demonstrated for those three; the pattern is asserted, not proven, for the remainder.
Structural counts are whole-checkout measurements and are reliable.
One reviewer hypothesis (-O renders V17 vacuous) was falsified during the audit and is recorded as N-AUDIT-001.
The reviewer claims no Clay canonical authority and requests no promotion.
